# Validation

This follow-up keeps Flare's compact cards and configurable appearance. Complete filenames now wrap on every pointer type; generic files lose their separate preview band. Selection has a visible label, and permitted Delete actions stay below the file menu's scrolling actions. Queued uploads show two files initially, with an expandable list and a persistent batch action. Required-passkey sign-in brings the permitted methods forward. Password fields have individual visibility controls, setup confirms the password, local administrator drafts warn before leaving, and account deletion requires typing DELETE.
